head_label: harness_git_head is repository HEAD at harness time, not independent build provenance
limitations: A missing or mismatched build receipt, or a candidate source digest change, refuses the report before the harness starts; harness_git_head is auxiliary context only.

Native worker failure coverage is the storage_lifecycle scheduler's real PostgreSQL statement_timeout 57014. The synthetic trigger only induces the fault; the Rust error, classification and scope are not mocked.

No native fault was injected into webhooks background, workspace capture, workspace remote GC or durable dispatch in this drill; their scope wrapping is covered by unit tests only and is not claimed as native acceptance.
Worker attempt/generation correlation is unit-tested with persisted numeric values; this drill's scheduler timeout occurs before a job claim, so its event intentionally has no attempt or generation.
Session GC, sharding controller/reconciliation, journal/provisioning recovery, metrics workers, backup and the advisory publisher remain outside worker operation scope.
Acceptance is limited to the cases executed by this invocation and the attested executable named by its binary hash and compiled receipt.
